crime_highlights: the appellant and two others, disguised with hoodies and balaclavas, and armed with knives and an imitation handgun, forced their way into the victim’s apartment
When the victim resisted, he was seriously assaulted and threatened with death.
The firearm was pointed at him.
The victim suffered serious injuries, including orbital fractures and the permanent loss of his sight in one eye.
rationale_highlights: recognizing the impact of the intergenerational trauma experienced by his family and how it has contributed to his drug addiction
He applied R. v. Gladue, [1999] 1 S.C.R. 688 and R. v. Ipeelee, 2012 SCC 13, [2012] 1 S.C.R. 433 to the appellant’s circumstances
note: Appeal court only notes trial judge applied Gladue; never states effect on sentence.

crime_highlights: Ms. Sharma returned from a trip to Surinam, landing at Toronto Pearson International Airport with a suitcase containing 1971.5 grams of cocaine
rationale_highlights: for a female Aboriginal offender whose background and circumstances, when considered under the Gladue framework, would have pointed toward a conditional sentence had it been available

the effect of the impugned provisions is to exacerbate her disadvantage as an Aboriginal person by removing the one remedy that would have allowed the sentencing judge to give effect to the mandate of s. 718.2(e)

together with the Gladue factors which address her personal history, including her grandmother’s attendance at residential school, her survival of sexual violence, her experience in foster care, her lack of education and poverty
a conditional sentence served in the community would have been an appropriate sentence to achieve the sentencing objectives of s. 718.2(e)
I would therefore set aside the sentence of 17 months in prison and substitute a conditional sentence of 24 months less a day
note: Majority (Feldman J.A.) substitutes conditional sentence on Gladue factors; Miller J.A. dissents.

crime_highlights: The substances included heroin, fentanyl, and derivatives of fentanyl. Carfentanil was found in one of the packets.
Mr. Disher had in his possession a pair of brass knuckles
rationale_highlights: particular attention should be given to the circumstances of Aboriginal offenders, a class of offenders to which Ms. Weaver belongs
Sentencing judges are to give effect to the principles in s. 718.2(e) even where the offence is serious and the sentence involves imprisonment
note: Appeal reduces Weaver's sentence on restraint and rehabilitation, not Indigenous heritage.
